admissibility_rule: an equal-budget allocation-comparison instrument is ADMISSIBLE only when a constructive (lower/exact) bound on its achievable ceiling is >= kappa * registered_MDE; INADMISSIBLE only when a rigorous upper bound is < kappa * registered_MDE; otherwise CANNOT_CHECK (fail closed)
kappa_rationale: kappa=1 is the logical minimum: an instrument whose achievable ceiling is below its own registered MDE cannot generate the effect it is gating on, for any sample size.

kappa=1.2 adds a power margin: if the best achievable effect sits exactly at the MDE, the best possible policy sits exactly at the gate and sampling noise makes a pass at best a coin flip; requiring 20% headroom above the MDE is the analogue of not powering a study at its own significance boundary.

kappa is deliberately modest because the INADMISSIBLE branch already carries built-in conservatism: it may only be licensed by an UPPER bound, and every relaxation looseness inflates that bound, making INADMISSIBLE harder, not easier, to reach.
chronology_disclosure: This freeze precedes the construction and ceiling computation of every fresh-assurance case and of any successor instrument (their seeds and definitions are declared below and had not been executed when this file was written).

It does NOT precede the reference instrument's ceiling, which was computed earlier and is already merged in research/paper4_allocator_attribution_v1/CEILING_BOUNDS.json (tier-3 upper bound 0.024571 vs MDE 0.05).

For the reference instrument the verdict is therefore kappa-insensitive rather than kappa-chosen: INADMISSIBLE holds for every kappa > 0.4914, so no choice of kappa >= 1 could alter it. The reference verdict is a formalization of an already-preserved finding, not a chronology-clean discovery; the fresh-assurance cases below carry the chronology-clean demonstration.
falsifiability_audit_obligation: before any confirmatory use, the gate must pass a per-condition black-box audit via src/rakl/gate_falsifiability.py, control condition first, with expected SENSITIVE/INSENSITIVE outcomes declared per probe in the audit receipt; INSENSITIVE-where-sensitivity-was-expected fails the audit
hard_obligations_restated: kappa and the registered MDE may never be revised after ceiling access
an INADMISSIBLE verdict may never be upgraded by arm-outcome access
a policy score may never license INADMISSIBLE
an uncomputable oracle may never yield ADMISSIBLE
the gate never promotes, revives, or reverses any allocator terminal
